# WL15 · Khung · đang tải phiên

Group **WL · Đăng nhập, khung & mẫu tin (Next.js)** · state · Next.js: **exists (design W2)** (`(app shell)`) · account `anonymous`

## Purpose
State of the shell: đang tải phiên. Page: The Next.js shell around every signed-in page: sidebar with the menu filtered by permission, top bar, phone tab bar and the empty, loading and forbidden states.

## Agent and care context
- Care and agent administration entries appear only for roles that hold their permissions (care.read, care.admin, care.matrix, admin.*). Planned old screens are listed as grey text with the tooltip "Màn này sẽ có ở bản sau" and are not links.

## Who may see it
- Account in this frame: `anonymous` (a mock account of `mock/auth.ts`; the back end decides the real matrix, the menu is a convenience).
- Gate: Signed-in session; each menu entry is shown when the role holds any permission of its `needs` (a convenience, the back end authorises every request).
- Roles that can open the page: owner and manager see every entry; doctor, cs_staff and reception see fewer; a patient account has no staff menu.
- Menu entry: not a menu entry (reached by link, redirect or the shell itself).

## Key actions
- (actions of the page; this state or dialog adds the controls its Layout lists)
- Menu entries by section: "Không gian làm việc", "Quản lý", "Phân tích", "Zalo & CSKH", "Care agent", "Quản trị agent"
- Theme toggle, sign out, global patient search, bell (link to the inbox)
- Phone: bottom tab bar and menu drawer
